r: I heard that you are fond of mead.
The thieves are planning an escape for their friend.
I recently talked to the watchman who blocks the old pathway to the Duleian Road. Why don't you just pay the woodcutter?

fallhaven_warden_1.m: Mead? Oh ... no, I don't do that anymore. Who told you that?

fallhaven_warden_10.m: Thank you kid, you really are nice. Now leave me to enjoy my drink.

fallhaven_warden_11.m: Hello again, kid. Thanks for the drink earlier. I had it all in one go. It sure tasted a bit different than before, but I guess that is just because I'm not used to it anymore.
r: I recently talked to the watchman who blocks the old pathway to the Duleian Road. Why don't you just pay the woodcutter?

fallhaven_warden_12.m: Hello again, kid. Thanks for the drink earlier. I still haven't had it.

fallhaven_warden_2.m: I've stopped doing that years ago.
r: Sounds like a good approach. Good luck with keeping away from it.
Not just even a little bit?

fallhaven_warden_20.m: Really, they would dare go up against the guard in Fallhaven? Do you have any details on their plan?
r: I heard they are planning his escape tonight.
No, I was just kidding with you. Never mind.
On second thought, I better not upset the Thieves' Guild. Never mind I said anything.

fallhaven_warden_21.m: Tonight? Thank you for this information. We will make sure to increase the security tonight then, but in such a way that they won't notice.

fallhaven_warden_22.m: When they do decide to break him free, we will be prepared. Maybe we can arrest more of those filthy thieves.

fallhaven_warden_23.m: Thank you again for the information. I'm not sure how you may know this, but I really appreciate you telling me.

fallhaven_warden_24.m: I want you to go one step further and tell them that we will have less security for tonight. But instead we will increase the security. That way we can really be ready for them.

fallhaven_warden_25.m: Good. Report back to me when you have told them.

r: I brought some with me if you would like to have a sip.

fallhaven_warden_30.m: Hello again, my friend. Did you tell those thieves that we will lower our security tonight?
r: Yes, they won't expect a thing.
No, not yet. I'm working on it.

fallhaven_warden_31.m: Great. Thank you for your help. Here, take these coins as a token of our appreciation.

fallhaven_warden_35.m: Hello again, my friend. Thank you for your help in dealing with the thieves earlier.

fallhaven_warden_36.m: I will make sure to tell other guards how you helped us here in Fallhaven.
r: I recently talked to the watchman who blocks the old pathway to the Duleian Road. Why don't you just pay the woodcutter?

fallhaven_warden_4.m: Oh sweet drinks of joy. I really shouldn't have this while on duty though.

fallhaven_warden_5.m: I could get fined for drinking on duty. I don't think I would dare try it right now.

fallhaven_warden_6.m: Thank you for the drink though, I will enjoy it when I get home later tomorrow.
r: What if someone would pay you the amount of the fine?

fallhaven_warden_7.m: Oh, that sounds a bit shady. I doubt anyone could afford the 450 gold around here. Anyway, I would need a bit more than that just to risk it.
r: I have 500 gold right here that you could have.
You know you want the mead right?
Yes, I agree. This is starting to sound too shady. Goodbye.

fallhaven_warden_8.m: Oh sure. Now that you mention it. It sure would be good.
r: So what if I pay you, say, 400 gold. Would that cover enough of your anxiety to enjoy the drink now?
This is starting to sound too shady for me. I'll leave you to your duty, goodbye.
I'll go get that gold for you. Goodbye.

fallhaven_warden_9.m: Wow, that much gold? I'm sure I could even get away with this without being fined. Then I could have the gold AND a nice drink of mead at the same time.

fallhaven_warden_pathway_1.m: Hah! Jakrar? I should pay Jakrar before he has done his work? No way! Either he does his woodcutting job before I pay him or the passage stays blocked! That's how I always do it. It's the only way to get the job done well.

fallhaven_warden_pathway_2.m: No way! Get lost or I'll throw you in jail! Talk to that filthy woodcutter if you want to reopen the path, but nothing will change my mind!
r: So where can I find him?

fallhaven_warden_pathway_3.m: He lives in his hut, immediately south of my prison. Don't you bother me again!
r: I wanted to leave your shabby prison anyway.

warden_prisoner_1.m: That thief? He was caught in the act. Trespassing he was. Trying to get down into the catacombs of Fallhaven church.

warden_prisoner_2.m: Luckily, we caught him before he could get down there. Now he'll serve as an example to all other thieves.

warden_prisoner_3.m: Damn thieves. There must be a nest of them around here somewhere. If only I could find where they hide.

farrik.10: Farrik in the Fallhaven Thieves' Guild told me of a plan to help a fellow thief escape from the Fallhaven jail.
farrik.20: Farrik in the Fallhaven Thieves' Guild told me the details of the plan, and I accepted the task of helping him. The guard captain apparently has a drinking problem. The plan is that I get a prepared mead from the cook in the Thieves' Guild that will knock out the guard captain in the jail. I might be required to bribe the guard captain.
farrik.25: I got the prepared mead from the cook in the Thieves' Guild.
farrik.30: I told Farrik that I don't fully agree with their plan. I might tell the guard captain about their shady plan.
farrik.32: I have given the prepared mead to the guard captain.
farrik.40: I have told the guard captain of the plan that the thieves have to release their friend.
farrik.50: The guard captain wants me to tell the thieves that the security will be lowered for tonight. We might be able to catch some of the thieves.
farrik.60: I managed to bribe the guard captain into drinking the prepared mead. He should be out during the night allowing the thieves to break their friend free.
farrik.70: Farrik rewarded me for helping the Thieves' Guild.
farrik.80: I have told Farrik that the security will be lowered tonight.
farrik.90: The guard captain thanked me for helping him plan to catch the thieves. He said he will also tell other guards that I helped him.

pathway_fallhaven: A path to the Duleian Road

pathway_fallhaven.10: I talked to a guard in the east of Fallhaven. He watches over the old passage to the Duleian Road, which is now blocked by fallen trees. If I want to help opening the path I should talk to his superior, the guard captain in the Fallhaven prison.
pathway_fallhaven.20: I talked to the guard captain. I wasn't able to convince him, but he advised me to talk to the woodcutter Jakrar, who lives just south of Fallhaven's prison.
pathway_fallhaven.30: I talked to Jakrar the woodcutter. He will only clear the trees away if I do him a favor. I should search for his favorite axe east of the Crossroads Guardhouse, located to the north of Fallhaven. I should keep my eyes open for an evil wolf pack.
pathway_fallhaven.40: I showed Jakrar the axe I found and he recognized it immediately.
pathway_fallhaven.50: Jakrar was very happy to see his good old axe again. He expressed his gratitude, and started to clear away the trees immediately.
pathway_fallhaven.60: Now the woodcutter has cleared away all the trees that blocked the path. Finally, the townsfolk have got back their shortcut to the Duleian Road!

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
